import os, resource, sys
n = int(sys.argv[1])
soft, hard = resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_STACK)
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_STACK, (n if hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(n, hard), hard))
os.execv(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:])
